beats.vo: Hi champ! Welcome to Chapter five, the last chapter of Unit one!
beats.caption: Chapter 5 · the last one in Unit 1!

beats.vo: You already know what a computer is, how it thinks, its devices, and how websites talk.
beats.caption: Computers · Binary · Devices · Websites

beats.vo: Today's big one: Being Safe Online!
beats.caption: Chapter 5 · Being Safe Online

beats.vo: You'll learn three super rules that protect you, just like a shield.
beats.caption: 3 super safety rules

beats.vo: Imagine you're playing a game online, and a message pops up: Hi! I'm ten too. Want to be friends?
beats.caption: "Hi! I'm 10 too. Want to be friends?"

beats.vo: Quick question. Can you see who is really typing? Think!
beats.caption: Can you see who is really typing?

beats.vo: Nope! Online, anyone can pretend to be anyone. It could be a kid, or a grown-up stranger.
beats.caption: Online, anyone can pretend to be anyone

beats.vo: That's why smart champs follow three safety rules. Let's go!
beats.caption: Smart champs follow 3 rules

beats.vo: Rule one: private info stays private.
beats.caption: Rule 1: Private info stays private

beats.vo: Private info means your full name, your school, your home address, and your phone number.
beats.caption: Full name · School · Home address · Phone number

beats.vo: One piece looks small. But put them together, and it's like a map that leads a stranger straight to your door!
beats.caption: Together, they make a map to your door!

beats.vo: So what can you share? Your favourite colour, a game nickname, or your drawing. Totally fine!
beats.caption: OK to share: favourite colour, nickname, drawing

beats.vo: Say it with me: private stays private!
beats.caption: Say it: Private stays private!

beats.vo: Game time! Safe post, or unsafe post? Answer fast!
beats.caption: Game: Safe or unsafe?

beats.vo: Post one: I love mango ice cream!
beats.caption: Post 1: "I love mango ice cream!"

beats.vo: Safe! Everybody can know that.
beats.caption: SAFE! Anyone can know that

beats.vo: Post two: Hi, I'm Riya from Green Park School, and I live on Rose Street!
beats.caption: Post 2: name + school + street

beats.vo: Unsafe! Name, school and street, all together. That's the map again!
beats.caption: UNSAFE! That's a map to Riya's door

beats.vo: Post three: a photo of my new drawing.
beats.caption: Post 3: "Look at my new drawing!"

beats.vo: Safe! Just don't show your school badge or house number in the picture.
beats.caption: SAFE! (no school badge or house number)

beats.vo: Rule two: your password is a secret key.
beats.caption: Rule 2: Your password is a secret key

beats.vo: It locks your games and accounts, just like a key locks your home.
beats.caption: It locks your games and accounts

beats.vo: Keep it secret from everyone, even your best friend! Only your mum and dad can know it.
beats.caption: Secret, even from friends. Only parents know.

beats.vo: A weak password is easy to guess, like one two three four, or your own name.
beats.caption: Weak: 1234 or your name

beats.vo: A strong one is long and mixed up, with words, numbers and symbols. Like Tiger, Jumps, seven, Mango!
beats.caption: Strong: long + words + numbers + symbols

beats.vo: Tip: make your own. Never copy the one on the screen!
beats.caption: Make your OWN. Never copy one from a screen.

beats.vo: Your turn! Which is stronger: a b c one two three, or Blue Kite Runs forty two?
beats.caption: Which is stronger? abc123 or BlueKite!Runs42

beats.vo: Blue Kite Runs forty two! It's longer and mixed up, so it's way harder to guess.
beats.caption: B! Longer + mixed = harder to guess

beats.vo: Rule three: if a chat feels odd, tell a trusted adult.
beats.caption: Rule 3: Odd chat? Tell a trusted adult

beats.vo: Odd means someone asks for photos, asks where you live, or says: don't tell your parents. Those are red flags!
beats.caption: Red flags: photos, where you live, "don't tell"

beats.vo: Then do three things. Stop. Don't reply. Tell a grown-up you trust.
beats.caption: Stop → Don't reply → Tell a grown-up

beats.vo: Who? Your mum or dad, your teacher, or your nani and nana.
beats.caption: Mum or Dad · Teacher · Nani & Nana

beats.vo: And remember, you are never in trouble for telling. Telling is brave!
beats.caption: You're never in trouble for telling

beats.vo: Practice check, just like the quiz!
beats.caption: Practice check

beats.vo: A new online friend asks for your home address. What do you do? A: tell them. B: tell only your street. Or C: don't share, and tell a trusted adult.
beats.caption: A new online friend asks for your address…

beats.vo: C! Never share your address. Tell a grown-up right away. Well done!
beats.caption: C: Don't share. Tell a trusted adult.

beats.vo: Let's lock it in! Rule one: private info stays private.
beats.caption: Rule 1: Private info stays private

beats.vo: Rule two: passwords are secret, even from friends.
beats.caption: Rule 2: Passwords are secret

beats.vo: Rule three: odd chat? Stop, don't reply, and tell a trusted adult.
beats.caption: Rule 3: Stop, don't reply, tell an adult

beats.vo: And three things never to post: your full name, your school, and your home address.
beats.caption: Never post: full name · school · home address

beats.vo: Chapter five done, and Unit one complete! You're a safe online champ!
beats.caption: Unit 1 complete!

beats.vo: Now a quick quiz. Tap Finish, and let's go!
beats.caption: Next: Quiz · Tap Finish
